name: Aperture
author: Masthead
description: A large, image-first theme for photographers. One post is one photograph; tags filter one big mosaic.

tokens.label: Navigation
tokens.description: A slim top bar, or a fixed column on the left. Both become a top bar on phones.

tokens.label: Sidebar text
tokens.description: A short note at the bottom of the sidebar. Only shown with the sidebar navigation.

tokens.label: Gallery URL
tokens.description: Where your Gallery page lives. Used by 'View all', tag links and 'Back to gallery'.

tokens.label: Columns on desktop
tokens.description: 2 to 6. Fewer columns on tablets and phones.

tokens.label: Colour scheme
tokens.description: 'system' follows the visitor's light/dark setting. 'light' or 'dark' locks it.

post_options.label: Photo
post_options.description: The photograph. Posts without a photo don't appear in the gallery.

post_options.label: Alt text
post_options.description: Describes the photo for screen readers. Falls back to the title.

post_options.label: Tile size
post_options.description: Preferred size in the gallery. 'auto' picks one from a rhythm so the mosaic stays varied.

post_options.label: Crop focus
post_options.description: Which part of the photo stays visible when a tile crops it.

post_options.label: Camera
post_options.description: Free text, e.g. 'Leica M6 · 35mm · f/8 · 1/250 · Portra 400'.

page_options.label: Show navigation
page_options.description: Untick to hide the navigation on this page only.
